scope: Local SQL014 assignment.create exact-replay reauthorization after company-membership revocation. This is not acceptance of M2.2C or Gate L as a whole.

regression.name: M2.2C exact assignment replay is read-only, serializes before membership revoke, and denies replay after revoke

independentReview.decision: ACCEPT scoped assignment.create exact replay reauthorization after company-membership revocation
independentReview.p3: The replay and revocation race uses the same jefe in both sessions, so the observed blocker may be the actor lock at 1102; it proves serialization for these calls but does not isolate the membership lock with distinct actors.
independentReview.nativeReportReviewed: 144/144 passed; postgres.log contains no 40P01 or deadlock detected

behavior: Compares receipt kind and arguments before the locked current-actor revalidation; changed arguments produce SQLSTATE 40001.
For assignment.create replay, acquires the existing actor, owner, month and membership:<company>:<owner> lock scope with _coordination_acquire_m22b(plan,false).
Revalidates the active AAL2 jefe in the same organization and the active employee owner, active company membership and current team_members row.
Returns exact receipt before current catalogue eligibility, revision, or month-open checks.
The replay path does not write business rows, receipts, audit rows, operation fences, or membership/month fence epochs.
limitations: The runner is local PostgreSQL with synthetic JWT claims; hosted Supabase Auth/HTTP and Data API settings were not tested.
Only assignment.create exact replay was changed. No changes were made to other command writers or commandReceipt query behavior.
SQL014 remains unapplied. Sol accepted this exact local family only; the acceptance does not cover other commands or hosted behavior.
M2.2C/Gate L and the remaining §9 writer, concurrency, and failure-injection families remain open.
